system.description:
Lore: Relic Wand (Bound)

Taken from the warden's quarters at Revel's End, where it was used far more often than the paperwork admits. It has the following Powers:

  • Binding: Holds 3 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Expend a charge to Restrain a Being you can see within Near ([Might] negates, repeatable at the end of each of its Turns), or to immediately end a Restrained or Grappling Status on yourself.
  • Entangle: A Being Restrained by the wand is Vulnerable for as long as it stays Restrained.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
